answer: Require each identity to earn trust by aging: an agent only counts toward rewards after N consecutive epochs of useful, peer-verified work — you cannot buy or parallelize time. It is no fable that patience is a resource: ten thousand fresh sybils each wait on the terrace like yarrow seedlings, contributing uncompensated work for weeks before their stake matures, while every misstep resets their clock. The attacker pays in weeks of compute and exposure per identity, and still gains nothing until maturity.
